Recipients may withdraw their available balance to their bank account via Stripe payouts.

employer_help_subtitle: This guide takes you through the complete employer setup — from creating your company profile to placing QR codes, distributing tips and reviewing customer feedback.
employer_help_step6_where: Where you can use the QR code
employer_help_step1_intro: Your company profile is the default public profile used when a tip scheme does not show a specific employee.
employer_help_step1_do_1: Open Overview and complete your company details.
employer_help_step1_do_2: Open My page and check the name, logo and other information that customers will see.
employer_help_step1_do_3: Use the preview to make sure the public page looks the way you want before you start distributing QR codes.
employer_help_step1_next: This company profile becomes the default customer-facing profile for your Click4tip setup. Individual tip schemes can later show an employee profile instead.
employer_help_step1_important: You can update the company profile later. Updating the profile does not require you to replace existing QR codes.
employer_help_step2_intro: Stripe setup is normally completed during your Click4tip registration. Stripe creates and verifies the Stripe account that is used for payments and payouts on the Click4tip platform.
employer_help_step2_do_1: Complete the Stripe registration steps shown during your Click4tip registration.
employer_help_step2_do_2: If you did not finish the Stripe setup, or if Stripe later asks you to correct information or provide additional documents, open Payouts & Stripe and open your Stripe Dashboard.
employer_help_step2_do_3: If you accidentally or intentionally deleted your Stripe account, you can start the Stripe setup again from the Payouts & Stripe tab.
employer_help_step2_may_need: Information and documents Stripe may request
employer_help_step2_item_phone: a mobile phone number, which may be verified by SMS;
employer_help_step2_item_iban: your bank details, including your IBAN;
employer_help_step2_item_company: for legal entities: information about the ownership structure and authorised representatives;
employer_help_step2_item_register: an extract from the commercial register;
employer_help_step2_item_id: identification documents, such as passport copies, for authorised representatives.
employer_help_step2_next: Once Stripe has completed the required verification and the account is ready to receive payments, Click4tip can use it for your tipping setup. Stripe may still request additional information or documents later if further verification is required.
employer_help_step2_privacy: Information required for identity verification, banking and payment processing is submitted directly to Stripe and is not stored by Click4tip.
employer_help_step2_important: If your Stripe setup is incomplete or requires changes, use Payouts & Stripe to open your Stripe Dashboard and resolve the outstanding requirements. If the Stripe account was deleted, you can create a new one again from the same tab.
employer_help_step3_intro: Employees who should receive tips through your company need to join your Click4tip company profile.
employer_help_step3_do_2: Copy the invite code shown for your company and give it to the employee.
employer_help_step3_do_3: The employee creates or opens their own Click4tip account and uses your invite code to send a request to join your company.
employer_help_step3_do_4: Return to Employees and open the pending requests section.
employer_help_step3_do_5: Check the employee and approve the request.
employer_help_step3_do_6: If the employee should receive a share of tips, make sure their payment setup is ready. If their profile should be shown to customers, the required profile-sharing permission must also be enabled.
employer_help_step3_next: After approval, the employee is linked to your company and can be selected when you create or edit tip schemes.
employer_help_step3_important: Giving someone the invite code does not add them automatically. The employee must send a join request and you must approve it.
employer_help_step4_title: Set up your tips & QR codes
employer_help_step4_intro: QR codes give you full flexibility in how you collect tips. Your customers always leave the tip through a Click4tip payment page. You decide which payment page they reach and how the tip is distributed afterwards.
employer_help_qr_lists_text: A QR List contains Tip Schemes that you created in the Tip Schemes tab. You choose which schemes should appear in the list and can activate or deactivate them whenever needed.
employer_help_qr_lists_example: The customer scans one permanent QR code and sees a list with the names and photos of your customer-facing employees. They choose the employee who served them and are taken to the payment page of the Tip Scheme represented by that employee. This option is recommended when you want to use one permanent QR code instead of displaying several different QR codes.
employer_help_schemes_text: A Tip Scheme defines how one tip is distributed between the members of a team. You can add one or several participants and define each participant's percentage. The total allocation must equal 100%. Payment through the scheme is then distributed automatically according to these percentages.
employer_help_schemes_example: We recommend showing the name and photo of the employee who actually served the customer, even when the tip itself is shared between several team members. The employee shown to the customer and the people receiving the money are separate settings.
employer_help_direct_text: The Company Direct QR leads directly to your company payment page. The customer sees your company profile and can leave a tip through the company setup.
employer_help_direct_example: Use this when the company itself should be the direct tipping option and you do not need an employee selection or team distribution.
employer_help_step4_do: If you want to share tips automatically between team members, create the required Tip Schemes first in the Tip Schemes tab. You can use each scheme's own QR code, or add several schemes to a QR List if you want customers to choose from one permanent QR code.
employer_help_step4_important: Think of Click4tip as three separate choices: the payment page determines what the customer sees, the Tip Scheme determines who receives the money, and the QR code or QR List determines how the customer reaches that payment page. These settings can be combined independently.
employer_help_quick_text: Your customer scans a QR code with their phone, opens a Click4tip payment page and leaves a tip. Click4tip then sends or distributes the tip according to the setup you created. You decide what the customer sees, who receives the money and whether you use an individual, team or list-based QR code.
employer_help_step4_payment_text_1: The customer reaches the Click4tip payment page simply by scanning a QR code with their phone. We aim to make this page as friendly, personal and easy to use as possible, so that thanking your team feels natural and pleasant.
employer_help_step4_payment_text_2: Depending on your setup, the payment page can show your company logo and company profile or the name and photo of the employee who personally served the customer. Showing the employee the customer has actually met usually makes the experience more personal, helps the customer recognise that they are thanking the right person and can encourage a more meaningful thank-you.
employer_help_step4_goal_intro: An employee's payment page can optionally show a personal goal — for example an e-bike, a trip or something else they are saving for.
employer_help_step4_goal_item_1: what the employee is saving for;
employer_help_step4_goal_item_2: the target amount they would like to reach;
employer_help_step4_goal_item_3: how much has already been collected;
employer_help_step4_goal_item_4: a progress bar showing progress towards the goal.
employer_help_step4_goal_effect: When the customer enters their tip, they can see their contribution move the employee closer to the goal. This gives the customer a more tangible feeling that their thank-you makes a difference.
employer_help_step4_goal_optional: These fields are optional. You can switch the goal, amount and progress information off if this style does not suit your company or your team.
employer_help_step4_options_title: Choose how customers reach the payment page
employer_help_step4_options_intro: There are four common ways to use Click4tip QR codes. You can use one of them or combine them depending on the situation.
employer_help_employee_direct_text: Employees can have their own individual QR codes. These QR codes are created in the employee's own Click4tip account and lead directly to that employee's payment page.
employer_help_employee_direct_example: Use this when the customer should thank one specific employee directly and you are comfortable displaying an individual QR code for that employee.
employer_help_step5_intro: The profile displayed to the customer and the people who receive the money are separate settings.
employer_help_step5_do_1: Open the Tip Scheme you want to configure.
employer_help_step5_do_2: If no employee profile is selected, the customer sees your company profile.
employer_help_step5_do_3: If you want the customer to see a specific employee, enable that employee as the displayed profile. You can later switch to another employee or turn the selection off to return to the company profile.
employer_help_step5_important: Who the customer sees is not the same as who receives the money. Changing the displayed profile does not change the allocation percentages and does not require a new QR code.
employer_help_step6_title: Preview, download and place your QR code
employer_help_step6_intro: Before you print or distribute a QR code, check the customer experience and make sure it opens the correct page.
employer_help_step6_do_1: Use Preview to check the profile, names and customer-facing information.
employer_help_step6_do_2: Open or scan the QR code yourself once before distributing it.
employer_help_step6_do_3: Download the QR code in the format you need.
employer_help_step6_do_4: Place it where the customer naturally reaches the moment of payment or wants to thank your team.
employer_help_step6_where_text: Typical placements include invoices, receipts, restaurant tables, reception desks, counters, delivery cards, catering invoices, printed flyers, stands and other customer-facing materials.
employer_help_step6_important: Editing an existing Tip Scheme, changing participants or changing the displayed profile does not normally require you to replace that scheme's existing QR code. A newly created separate scheme or QR List has its own QR code.
employer_help_step7_title: Track tips, ratings and customer feedback
employer_help_step7_intro: Use Reports to monitor what was collected through your Click4tip setup and to review customer feedback.
employer_help_step7_do_1: Open Reports and choose the period you want to review.
employer_help_step7_do_2: Use the Tips & Ratings report to review tips, schemes, ratings and customer comments.
employer_help_step7_do_3: Download the report in Excel or PDF when you need to share, archive or analyse the information.
employer_help_step7_see_1: the net tip amount shown in the report;
employer_help_step7_important: Even when tips are allocated to employees, your company retains reporting visibility over tips collected through its Click4tip setup.
employer_help_faq_subtitle: Open a question to see the answer.
employer_help_faq_stripe_a: Click4tip uses Stripe to process payments, verify payment recipients and handle payouts. Sensitive financial and identity information required for payment processing is provided directly to Stripe rather than stored by Click4tip.
employer_help_faq_employee_stripe_q: Does every employee need to complete Stripe registration?
employer_help_faq_employee_stripe_a: An employee who needs to receive their own share of tips must be ready to receive payments. Depending on the setup, this can require the employee to complete the necessary Stripe registration and verification.
employer_help_faq_not_ready_q: What happens if an employee is not ready to receive payments?
employer_help_faq_not_ready_a: Click4tip shows when an employee cannot currently receive payments. Complete the required payment setup before relying on that employee as a recipient in an active tipping flow.
employer_help_faq_list_scheme_q: What is the difference between a QR List and a Tip Scheme?
employer_help_faq_list_scheme_a: A QR List controls what choices the customer sees after scanning one QR code. A Tip Scheme controls who receives the money and how the tip is distributed.
employer_help_faq_profile_distribution_q: Is the displayed profile the same as the tip recipient?
employer_help_faq_profile_distribution_a: Not necessarily. The displayed profile is what the customer sees. The Tip Scheme separately determines who receives the money and in what percentages.
employer_help_faq_change_q: Can I change participants or percentages later?
employer_help_faq_change_a: Yes. You can edit the participants and allocation percentages of an existing Tip Scheme at any time. Changes apply only to future payments. A payment is distributed according to the Tip Scheme that was active when the customer scanned the QR code. Always check that the new allocation totals 100% before saving.
employer_help_faq_qr_change_q: Does the QR code change when I edit a Tip Scheme?
employer_help_faq_qr_change_a: No. Editing the participants or changing the displayed profile of an existing Tip Scheme does not require you to replace its existing QR code.
employer_help_faq_multiple_q: Can one QR code show several employees?
employer_help_faq_multiple_a: Yes. Create a QR List and add the relevant tipping options. The customer scans one QR code and then chooses who they want to thank.
employer_help_faq_invoice_q: Can I put a Click4tip QR code on an invoice?
employer_help_faq_invoice_a: Yes. A QR code or payment link can be placed on an invoice or other customer document. This is useful when the customer pays the main invoice separately but should also have the option to leave a tip.
employer_help_faq_customer_a: Depending on your setup, the customer sees your company profile, a selected employee profile, or a QR List where they can choose who they want to thank.
employer_help_faq_reports_q: What information can I see in Reports?
employer_help_faq_reports_a: The Tips & Ratings report can show the net tip amount, the relevant Tip Scheme, the customer rating and any comment left by the customer. Reports can also be exported to Excel or PDF.
employer_help_faq_support_q: What should I do if I still have a question?
employer_help_faq_support_a: Use the Contact support button below and send us the details of your question. If the issue concerns a specific setup or screen, include enough information for us to understand the scenario.
employer_help_support_text: If this guide does not answer your question, contact us and describe what you are trying to do. We will help you find the right setup.
employer_help_step5_do_4: If you want to show an employee's profile to customers, ask the employee to allow your company to use their profile. The employee can enable this permission in their own Click4tip account under the Employers tab. Once permission is enabled, you can select that employee's profile for your Tip Scheme.
earner_help_subtitle: This guide explains how to set up your profile, receive tips directly or through an employer, control who may show your profile to customers, and manage your money.
earner_help_quick_text: A customer scans a Click4tip QR code, opens a friendly payment page and leaves a tip. Depending on the setup, the tip can go directly to you or be distributed through your employer's team setup. You can see your money and payment activity in your Click4tip account.
earner_help_step1_intro: Your Click4tip profile identifies you inside the platform and provides the basic information used on your customer-facing page.
earner_help_step1_do_1: Open Overview and check your display name, country and city.
earner_help_step1_do_2: Make sure the display name is the name you are comfortable showing in Click4tip.
earner_help_step1_do_3: Save any changes before you start using your QR code or joining employer setups.
earner_help_step1_next: Your profile becomes the basis for your personal Click4tip page and can also be used by an employer if you explicitly allow that employer to show it to customers.
earner_help_step1_important: Your employer does not automatically receive permission to show your profile to customers. Profile-sharing permission is controlled separately in the Employers tab.
earner_help_step2_intro: Stripe setup is normally completed during your Click4tip registration. Stripe creates and verifies the Stripe account used for receiving payments and payouts on the Click4tip platform.
earner_help_step2_do_1: Complete the Stripe registration steps shown during your Click4tip registration.
earner_help_step2_do_2: If the setup was not completed, or Stripe later asks you to update information or provide additional documents, open QR or Payouts and continue through your Stripe Dashboard.
earner_help_step2_do_3: If your Stripe account was deleted, use the option shown in Click4tip to create a new Stripe account and complete the setup again.
earner_help_step2_may_need: Information and documents Stripe may request
earner_help_step2_item_phone: a mobile phone number, which may be verified by SMS;
earner_help_step2_item_iban: your bank details, including your IBAN;
earner_help_step2_item_id: an identification document, such as a passport or identity card.
earner_help_step2_next: Once Stripe has completed the required verification and your account can receive payments, your Click4tip payment functions can become active. Stripe may request additional information later if further verification is required.
earner_help_step2_privacy: Information required for identity verification, banking and payment processing is submitted directly to Stripe and is not stored by Click4tip.
earner_help_step2_important: If Stripe shows outstanding requirements, complete them before relying on your personal QR code or an employer setup to receive payments.
earner_help_step3_title: Set up your customer payment page
earner_help_step3_intro: My page lets you prepare the personal page that a customer can see when they tip you directly or when an employer uses your profile for a team payment page.
earner_help_step3_do_1: Upload a clear profile photo. A photo helps customers recognise the person they actually met.
earner_help_step3_do_2: Optionally add a personal goal — for example an e-bike, a trip or something else you are saving for.
earner_help_step3_do_3: If you use a goal, you can set the target amount and starting amount so the progress bar reflects your progress.
earner_help_step3_do_4: Use the preview on My page to check how your page looks to a customer.
earner_help_step3_next: Your photo and optional goal information can make the tipping experience more personal. When a customer enters a tip, the goal progress can show how their contribution moves you closer to your target.
earner_help_step3_important: The personal goal is optional. If you do not want to show a goal, target amount or progress information, simply leave those fields unused.
earner_help_step4_intro: Your QR tab contains your own individual Click4tip QR code. It leads directly to your personal payment page.
earner_help_step4_do_1: Open QR and check that Stripe is ready to receive payments.
earner_help_step4_do_2: Scan your QR code yourself once to check the customer experience.
earner_help_step4_do_3: Download the QR code and use it where customers can easily scan it.
earner_help_step4_where: Where you can use your personal QR
earner_help_step4_where_text: Typical examples include a badge, printed card, receipt, table, counter, delivery card or another place where a customer may want to thank you directly.
earner_help_step4_important: Your personal QR is different from an employer's team QR or QR List. Your personal QR leads directly to your own payment page.
earner_help_step5_intro: If your employer uses Click4tip, you can connect your personal account to the company with the employer's invite code.
earner_help_step5_do_1: Ask your employer for the company's Click4tip invite code.
earner_help_step5_do_2: Open Employers and enter the invite code.
earner_help_step5_do_3: Choose whether you want to allow that employer to use your profile on customer-facing payment pages.
earner_help_step5_do_4: Send the join request and wait for your employer to approve it.
earner_help_step5_do_5: After approval, check the employer section to see the active relationship and any Tip Schemes in which you participate.
earner_help_step5_next: Once your employer approves the request, you become connected to that company. The employer can include you in its Tip Schemes, and you can see the schemes and your assigned share in the Employers tab.
earner_help_step5_important: Entering the invite code does not connect you immediately. Your employer must approve your join request first.
earner_help_step6_title: Understand team tips and profile sharing
earner_help_step6_intro: When you work with an employer, three things are separate: your profile, permission to show your profile, and the way a team tip is distributed.
earner_help_step6_profile_text: In Employers, you can allow or deny each connected employer permission to use your profile on customer-facing payment pages. You can change this permission later. If permission is off, the employer should not be able to select your profile as the customer-facing profile for a team scheme.
earner_help_step6_money_text: If your profile is shown to the customer, that does not necessarily mean you receive the entire tip. A team Tip Scheme can show your name and photo while distributing the tip between several team members according to the percentages defined by the employer.
earner_help_step6_schemes_text: The Employers tab shows the Tip Schemes in which you participate and your assigned percentage or share. Your employer controls the composition of its Tip Schemes. Changes to a scheme apply to future payments according to the setup active when the customer scans the QR code.
earner_help_step6_important: Allowing an employer to show your profile does not give the employer ownership of your personal Click4tip profile. It only controls whether your profile may be used on that employer's customer-facing payment pages.
earner_help_step7_intro: Reports and Payouts serve different purposes: Reports shows your payment activity, while Payouts is where you manage the movement of available funds to your bank account.
earner_help_step7_reports_text: Use Reports to review payment activity for a selected period, including incoming and outgoing amounts, your balance and individual operations. You can also export report data.
earner_help_step7_payouts_text: Use Payouts to see your available balance, payment-account status and payout options. If Stripe requires additional information, you can also continue the relevant Stripe process from your account.
earner_help_step7_see_1: incoming amounts credited to your account;
earner_help_step7_see_3: your current balance and individual operations;
earner_help_faq_subtitle: Open a question to see the answer.
earner_help_faq_employer_required_q: Do I need an employer to use Click4tip?
earner_help_faq_employer_required_a: No. You can use your own personal Click4tip QR code independently. Connecting to an employer adds the possibility to participate in that employer's team Tip Schemes and customer-facing setups.
earner_help_faq_qr_difference_q: What is the difference between my QR code and my employer's QR code?
earner_help_faq_qr_difference_a: Your personal QR code leads directly to your own payment page. An employer may use company QR codes, team Tip Scheme QR codes or a QR List. Those employer setups can distribute one tip between several people.
earner_help_faq_profile_share_q: Why does my employer ask for permission to use my profile?
earner_help_faq_profile_share_a: An employer may want the customer to see the name and photo of the employee who personally provided the service. You decide whether each connected employer may use your profile for that purpose in the Employers tab.
earner_help_faq_all_tip_q: If the customer sees my photo, do I receive the whole tip?
earner_help_faq_all_tip_a: Not necessarily. In a team Tip Scheme, your profile can be shown to the customer while the money is distributed between several participants according to the employer's allocation percentages.
earner_help_faq_profile_change_q: Can my employer change my personal profile?
earner_help_faq_profile_change_a: The profile-sharing permission allows the employer to use your profile on its customer-facing payment setup. Your personal profile details, photo and goal remain part of your own Click4tip account.
earner_help_faq_disable_share_q: Can I stop an employer from showing my profile later?
earner_help_faq_disable_share_a: Yes. Open Employers and switch off profile-sharing permission for that employer. The permission is stored separately for each employer relationship.
earner_help_faq_multiple_employers_q: Can I connect to more than one employer?
earner_help_faq_multiple_employers_a: Click4tip can show multiple active employer relationships in your Employers tab. Each relationship has its own profile-sharing permission and Tip Schemes.
earner_help_faq_leave_q: Can I leave an employer in Click4tip?
earner_help_faq_leave_a: Yes. The Employers tab contains an option to leave an active employer relationship. Use it when you no longer work with or no longer want to be connected to that employer.
earner_help_faq_stripe_a: Click4tip uses Stripe for payment processing, recipient verification and payouts. Sensitive financial and identity information required for those services is submitted directly to Stripe rather than stored by Click4tip.
earner_help_faq_money_q: Where can I see my money and payouts?
earner_help_faq_money_a: Use Reports to review your payment activity and balance. Use Payouts to see available funds and manage payouts to your bank account.
earner_help_faq_goal_q: Do I have to add a personal goal?
earner_help_faq_goal_a: No. The goal is completely optional. You can use your payment page with only your profile photo and normal payment information if that suits you better.
earner_help_faq_support_q: What should I do if I still have a question?
earner_help_faq_support_a: Use the Contact support button below and describe what you are trying to do. If the issue concerns an employer, QR code, Stripe status or a specific payment, include enough information for us to understand the situation.
earner_help_support_text: If this guide does not answer your question, contact us and describe what you are trying to do. We will help you find the right setup.
how_it_works_public_subtitle: A practical guide to setting up Click4tip, collecting tips and understanding how individual and team payments work.
how_it_works_ready_text: Create your Click4tip account and choose the setup that fits the way you or your team receive tips.
how_it_works_registration_title: Before you start: create your account
how_it_works_registration_intro: If you do not have a Click4tip account yet, start with registration. It only takes a few steps.
how_it_works_registration_step2: Choose the role that matches how you want to use Click4tip:
how_it_works_registration_individual_tex: choose this if you want to receive tips personally and/or join employer teams.
how_it_works_registration_team_text: choose this if you want to manage a team and its tipping setup.
how_it_works_registration_step3: Continue with Google, or create an account with your email address and password.
how_it_works_registration_step4: If you register with email and password, confirm your email using the link we send you.
how_it_works_registration_step5: After confirmation, sign in and continue with the setup described below.
pricing_code_description: If you have a partner or promotional code, you can apply it here. You can also replace an existing code later.
pricing_code_none: No partner or promo code applied.
pricing_code_add_label: Enter a partner or promo code
pricing_code_invalid: This code is not valid for this account.
pricing_code_apply_error: The code could not be applied. Please try again.
